integrity: All statements derived from elementary radial moments and an explicit asymptotic variational proof; symbolic and numerical checks provided as supporting reproducibility, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Degree-two fixed subspace and standard normalized radial power weights only. A finite-weight algebraic sharp-constant formula and uniqueness of the positive coefficient profile are not claimed. Priority outside inspected sources and independent validation are unverified.
title: Strict three-mode mixing and the sharp high-weight correction for quadratic Bergman fourth moments
